_comment: DA-1795 field-position mappings. These tell the parser which column holds what. The Data_Stream_Id mapping on invoice_launchpad is REQUIRED for MDS - without it the invoice cannot be associated to a stream. Verified live on pilot 73969, 24 Aug 2026.

configKVs.configDocumentation: MDS-REQUIRED. Maps invoice column 3 to the data stream id (the meter token, e.g. 911141002). Without this the invoice will not associate to a stream.
Maps METERENROLL column 11 to the solar flag. In the supplied METERENROLL file this column holds 'True'.
Maps USERENROLL column 35 to the solar flag. Sets homeAccounts.hasSolar=true, which is what the web dashboard reads to pick the SOLAR layout.
